title: Light Italian Vegetable Frittata
description: A garlicky and light Italian dish featuring a mix of vegetables and a hint of sweetness, perfect for a brunch mood, and made satvik-friendly by avoiding animal products, this frittata is a unique blend of flavors with powdered sugar and nuka-pickle adding depth.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the diced zucchini and bell peppers, and cook until they are tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, powdered sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked vegetables and chopped nuka-pickle to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
